parameters.subject: NURA Evaluation Packet — Depression screening
parameters.message: Please complete the depression screening questionnaire below. This packet is routed because a depression-related diagnosis was detected.

values.fieldLabel: 1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
2. Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
4. Feeling tired or having little energy
5. Poor appetite or overeating
6. Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
7. Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
8. Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
9. Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way
Anything else you want the clinician to know?

options.responseFormDescription: Please answer each item based on the last 2 weeks. If you are in immediate danger or thinking about self-harm, contact emergency services right now. The form also records OpenEMR demographics that were passed into the outbound packet.
options.responseFormCustomCss:
body { font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; }
label { font-weight: 600; }

parameters.subject: NURA Evaluation Packet — ADHD screening
parameters.message: Please complete the ADHD screening questionnaire below. This packet is routed because an ADHD-related diagnosis was detected.

values.fieldLabel: 1. How often do you have trouble wrapping up the final details of a project, once the challenging parts have been done?
2. How often do you have difficulty getting things in order when you have to do a task that requires organization?
3. How often do you have problems remembering appointments or obligations?
4. When you have a task that requires a lot of thought, how often do you avoid or delay getting started?
5. How often do you fidget or squirm with your hands or feet when you have to sit down for a long time?
6. How often do you feel overly active and compelled to do things, as if you were driven by a motor?
Brief examples from childhood, school, work, or home

options.responseFormDescription: Please answer each item honestly. Add examples if helpful. The form also records OpenEMR demographics that were passed into the outbound packet.

parameters.subject: NURA Evaluation Packet — Bipolar / mood cycling screening
parameters.message: Please complete the bipolar / mood cycling questionnaire below. This packet is routed because a bipolar-related diagnosis was detected.

values.fieldLabel: 1. Have there been periods when you felt so good or hyper that other people thought you were not your normal self or you were so hyper that you got into trouble?
2. Have you been so irritable that you shouted at people or started fights or arguments?
3. Have you felt much more self-confident than usual?
4. Have you gotten much less sleep than usual and found you did not really miss it?
5. Have you been much more talkative or felt pressure to keep talking?
6. Have thoughts raced through your head or did you feel you could not slow your mind down?
7. Were you so easily distracted by things around you that you had trouble concentrating?
8. Did you have more energy than usual?
9. Were you much more active or did you do many more things than usual?
10. Did you do things that were unusual for you or that other people might have thought were excessive, foolish, or risky?
Any history of mood cycling, psychosis, or hospitalization?

options.responseFormDescription: Please answer based on your lifetime history and any recent episodes. The form also records OpenEMR demographics that were passed into the outbound packet.

body { font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; }
label { font-weight: 600; }
